figures.caption: Figure 2: Simulated number of calls to the generative model made by nsampleV(ε, δ ′) as a function of 1/ε compared to our theoretical bound (Lemma 1) and to the number of calls that would be required by a Sparse Sampling strategy. The parameters used were: γ = 0.2, δ′ = 0.1, K = 2 and λ = 0.1.

Figure 3: Number of calls to the generative model made by nsampleV as a function of the regularization parameter λ in order to achieve a relative error of 0.01 (left) and its ratio with respect to the number of calls that would be required by Sparse Sampling in the same setting (right). The parameters used were: γ = 0.2, δ′ = 0.1 and K = 2.
